view.name: view_semantic_from_source
view.yaml:
name: shop_semantics
tables:
  - name: users
    base_table:
      database: '{catalog}'
      schema: '{schema}'
      table: users
    primary_key:
      columns: [user_id]
    dimensions:
      - name: user_id
        expr: user_id
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: country
        expr: country
        data_type: TEXT
    facts:
      - name: age
        expr: age
        data_type: NUMBER
  - name: orders
    base_table:
      database: '{catalog}'
      schema: '{schema}'
      table: orders
    primary_key:
      columns: [order_id]
    dimensions:
      - name: order_id
        expr: order_id
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: user_id
        expr: user_id
        data_type: NUMBER
    time_dimensions:
      - name: ts
        expr: ts
        data_type: TIMESTAMP_NTZ
    facts:
      - name: price
        expr: price
        data_type: FLOAT
      - name: price_with_tax
        expr: price * 1.2
        data_type: FLOAT
    metrics:
      - name: revenue
        expr: SUM(orders.price)
relationships:
  - name: orders_to_users
    left_table: orders
    right_table: users
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: user_id
        right_column: user_id
